application.title: Fixed Asset Management
application.description: Statutory fixed asset register, location & custody tracking, Companies Act and Income Tax depreciation, asset lifecycle (installation, transfer, disposal), physical verification and warranty/AMC management.

navigation.title: Home
navigation.description: Landing page with quick access to the Asset Register, dashboards and every functional area
navigation.functional_specs: Application landing/home page: hero banner with the app identity, quick-access cards to the Management Dashboard, Asset Depreciation Reconciliation and Asset Register, and grouped card sections for every functional area (Asset Register, Locations & Assignment, Depreciation - Companies Act, Depreciation - Income Tax, Asset Lifecycle, Physical Verification, Warranty & AMC, Reports & Analytics).

navigation.title: Asset Register
navigation.description: Asset classification and statutory asset register masters
navigation.functional_specs: Groups asset category classification master and the statutory Asset Register

navigation.title: Asset Category Master
navigation.description: Maintain the classification of assets used to default useful life, depreciation method and applicable statutory rates on the Asset Register.
navigation.functional_specs: Data points: CATEGORY_CODE (PK, unique), CATEGORY_NAME, PARENT_CATEGORY_CODE (optional self-lookup), COMPANIES_ACT_USEFUL_LIFE_YEARS, COMPANIES_ACT_DEFAULT_METHOD (SLM/WDV), COMPANIES_ACT_RESIDUAL_VALUE_PCT, INCOME_TAX_BLOCK_CODE (default, must exist in FAM_DEP_RATE_IT_MASTER.BLOCK_CODE), STATUS (Active/Inactive). Rules: CATEGORY_CODE unique; COMPANIES_ACT_USEFUL_LIFE_YEARS > 0 and mandatory when ASSET_TYPE = Fixed Asset, optional when ASSET_TYPE = Other Asset; COMPANIES_ACT_RESIDUAL_VALUE_PCT between 0 and 100 and mandatory when ASSET_TYPE = Fixed Asset, optional when ASSET_TYPE = Other Asset. Actions: Search, Add, Edit, Delete (only if unused), Activate/Deactivate. Deactivating blocks use on new Asset Register entries but does not affect existing assets. When Asset Type = Fixed Asset, Category Code, Category Name, Status, Asset Type, Useful Life (Years), Default Method, Residual Value % and Income Tax Block Code are all mandatory. When Asset Type = Other Asset, only Category Code, Category Name, Status and Asset Type are mandatory.

navigation.title: Asset Register
navigation.description: Capture and maintain the complete statutory record of each fixed asset as required under the Companies Act, from acquisition through its active life.
navigation.functional_specs: Data points: ASSET_CODE (auto), ASSET_NAME, CATEGORY_CODE (lookup FAM_ASSET_CATEGORY_MASTER.CATEGORY_CODE), PARENT_ASSET_CODE (optional self-lookup to FAM_ASSET_REGISTER.ASSET_CODE — links an asset to a parent asset; not mandatory), SERIAL_NO, MAKE, MODEL, DESCRIPTION, ASSET_PHOTO, QR_CODE/BARCODE_TAG, BRANCH_CODE (lookup FAM_BRANCH_MASTER.BRANCH_CODE), LOCATION_CODE (lookup FAM_LOCATION_MASTER.LOCATION_CODE), DEPARTMENT_CODE (lookup FAM_DEPARTMENT_MASTER.DEPARTMENT_CODE), ASSIGNED_EMPLOYEE_CODE (lookup FAM_EMPLOYEE_MASTER.EMPLOYEE_CODE), VENDOR_NAME (free text, no master lookup), PURCHASE_INVOICE_NO, PURCHASE_DATE, PURCHASE_COST, OTHER_CAPITALIZED_COST, TOTAL_CAPITALIZED_COST (computed = PURCHASE_COST + OTHER_CAPITALIZED_COST), CAPITALIZATION_DATE (>= PURCHASE_DATE), COMPANIES_ACT_USEFUL_LIFE_YEARS, COMPANIES_ACT_METHOD (SLM/WDV), COMPANIES_ACT_RESIDUAL_VALUE, INCOME_TAX_BLOCK_CODE, WARRANTY_START_DATE, WARRANTY_END_DATE, AMC_APPLICABLE (Y/N), STATUS (Draft/Pending Approval/Capitalized/Under Transfer/Disposed/Under Investigation), REMARKS. Rules: SERIAL_NO unique within CATEGORY_CODE; PURCHASE_COST > 0; TOTAL_CAPITALIZED_COST auto-computed; CAPITALIZATION_DATE >= PURCHASE_DATE; CATEGORY_CODE/BRANCH_CODE/LOCATION_CODE/DEPARTMENT_CODE must exist in their masters; VENDOR_NAME is free text, not validated against a master; core financial fields (PURCHASE_COST, CAPITALIZATION_DATE, CATEGORY_CODE) locked once STATUS = Capitalized. Actions: Search, Add, Edit, Delete (Draft only), Submit-for-approval, Approve (sets STATUS=Capitalized), Reject, Generate QR Code/Barcode Tag.

navigation.title: Locations & Assignment
navigation.description: Branch, location, department and employee custody masters
navigation.functional_specs: Groups organisational structure masters used for asset placement and custody assignment

navigation.title: Branch Master
navigation.description: Maintain organisation branches
navigation.functional_specs: Maintain BRANCH_CODE, BRANCH_NAME, ADDRESS, CITY, STATE, STATUS. Actions: Search, Add, Edit, Delete (only if unused), Activate/Deactivate. Rule: unique BRANCH_CODE.

navigation.title: Location Master
navigation.description: Maintain physical locations within a branch
navigation.functional_specs: Maintain LOCATION_CODE, LOCATION_NAME, BRANCH_CODE, ADDRESS/DESCRIPTION, STATUS. Actions: Search, Add, Edit, Delete (only if unused), Activate/Deactivate. Rules: unique LOCATION_CODE within BRANCH_CODE; BRANCH_CODE must exist in Branch Master.

navigation.title: Department Master
navigation.description: Maintain departments/cost centres within a branch
navigation.functional_specs: Maintain DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, BRANCH_CODE, COST_CENTRE_CODE, STATUS. Actions: Search, Add, Edit, Delete (only if unused), Activate/Deactivate. Rule: unique DEPARTMENT_CODE within BRANCH_CODE.

navigation.title: Employee Master
navigation.description: Lightweight employee directory for asset custody
navigation.functional_specs: Maintain EMPLOYEE_CODE, EMPLOYEE_NAME, BRANCH_CODE, DEPARTMENT_CODE, DESIGNATION, STATUS (Active/Inactive/Transferred), used solely to assign custody of assets. Actions: Search, Add, Edit, Delete (only if unused), Activate/Deactivate. Rules: unique EMPLOYEE_CODE; BRANCH_CODE and DEPARTMENT_CODE must exist. Deactivating an employee flags assigned assets for reassignment via Asset Transfer.

navigation.title: Depreciation - Companies Act
navigation.description: Schedule II depreciation rate maintenance and generation
navigation.functional_specs: Groups Companies Act (Schedule II) depreciation rate master and monthly generation activity

navigation.title: Depreciation Rate Master - Companies Act
navigation.description: Maintain Schedule II useful life, method and residual norms
navigation.functional_specs: Maintain CATEGORY_CODE, USEFUL_LIFE_YEARS, METHOD (SLM/WDV), RESIDUAL_VALUE_PCT, EFFECTIVE_FROM_DATE. Actions: Search, Add, Edit, Delete (only if unused). Rules: one active rate per CATEGORY_CODE at a time; residual 0-100%; useful life > 0.

navigation.title: Generate Depreciation - Companies Act
navigation.description: Compute and post pro-rata monthly Schedule II depreciation
navigation.functional_specs: Criteria: FINANCIAL_YEAR, PERIOD_MONTH, BRANCH_CODE (optional). Generates lines per capitalized asset: OPENING_WDV, ADDITIONS_DURING_MONTH, DISPOSALS_DURING_MONTH, DEPRECIATION_METHOD, MONTHLY_DEPRECIATION_AMOUNT, CLOSING_WDV, ACCUMULATED_DEPRECIATION, ADJUSTMENT_REMARKS. Actions: Generate (preview), Edit (adjustment only), Submit-for-approval, Approve & Post, Cancel, Close Financial Year (locks 12 posted periods, rolls forward closing WDV). Rules: pro-rata from CAPITALIZATION_DATE/Installation Date; stops in disposal month; CLOSING_WDV cannot go below residual; period cannot be regenerated once posted. On Approve & Post updates Asset Register accumulated depreciation/WDV and feeds Depreciation Register.

navigation.title: Depreciation - Income Tax
navigation.description: Block-of-assets depreciation rate maintenance and generation
navigation.functional_specs: Groups Income Tax block-of-assets depreciation rate master and annual generation activity

navigation.title: Depreciation Rate Master - Income Tax
navigation.description: Maintain block-of-assets rates under Income Tax Rules
navigation.functional_specs: Maintain BLOCK_CODE, BLOCK_DESCRIPTION, RATE_PCT, EFFECTIVE_FROM_DATE. Actions: Search, Add, Edit, Delete (only if unused). Rules: one active rate per BLOCK_CODE at a time; RATE_PCT 0-100.

navigation.title: Generate Depreciation - Income Tax
navigation.description: Compute and post annual block-wise WDV depreciation
navigation.functional_specs: Criteria: ASSESSMENT_YEAR, BLOCK_CODE (optional), BRANCH_CODE (optional). Source tables: FAM_ASSET_REGISTER (ASSET_CODE, INCOME_TAX_BLOCK_CODE, CAPITALIZATION_DATE, TOTAL_CAPITALIZED_COST, STATUS), FAM_ASSET_INSTALLATION (ASSET_CODE, INSTALLATION_DATE used as PUT_TO_USE_DATE when confirmed), FAM_ASSET_DISPOSAL (ASSET_CODE, DISPOSAL_DATE, SALE_VALUE used as disposal proceeds), FAM_DEP_RATE_IT_MASTER (BLOCK_CODE, RATE_PCT, EFFECTIVE_FROM_DATE). One output row per BLOCK_CODE (per BRANCH_CODE when branch filter applied). Output columns: OPENING_WDV (closing WDV from previous assessment year, or 0 for first year), ADDITIONS_180_DAYS_OR_MORE (TOTAL_CAPITALIZED_COST of assets first put to use in this FY on or before 3 October — use confirmed INSTALLATION_DATE if available, else CAPITALIZATION_DATE), ADDITIONS_LESS_THAN_180_DAYS (TOTAL_CAPITALIZED_COST of assets first put to use in this FY after 3 October), DISPOSALS_DURING_YEAR (sum of sale/insurance proceeds from FAM_ASSET_DISPOSAL where DISPOSAL_DATE falls in this FY and STATUS = Approved), RATE_PCT (from FAM_DEP_RATE_IT_MASTER, latest EFFECTIVE_FROM_DATE ≤ first day of the FY), DEPRECIATION_AMOUNT, CLOSING_WDV. Computation: NET_BLOCK = OPENING_WDV + ADDITIONS_180_DAYS_OR_MORE + ADDITIONS_LESS_THAN_180_DAYS − DISPOSALS_DURING_YEAR. If NET_BLOCK ≤ 0: DEPRECIATION_AMOUNT = 0, CLOSING_WDV = 0, STCG = |NET_BLOCK| shown in REMARKS. If NET_BLOCK > 0: DEPRECIATION_AMOUNT = max(0, OPENING_WDV + ADDITIONS_180_DAYS_OR_MORE − DISPOSALS_DURING_YEAR) × RATE_PCT + ADDITIONS_LESS_THAN_180_DAYS × (RATE_PCT × 50%), capped at NET_BLOCK; CLOSING_WDV = NET_BLOCK − DEPRECIATION_AMOUNT. Actions: Generate (preview), Edit (adjustment remarks only), Submit-for-approval, Approve & Post, Cancel. On Approve & Post: store CLOSING_WDV as next year OPENING_WDV per block and feed Depreciation Register. Period cannot be re-generated once posted.

navigation.title: Asset Lifecycle
navigation.description: Installation, transfer and disposal of assets
navigation.functional_specs: Groups asset installation confirmation, inter-branch/location/employee transfer and sale/scrap disposal activities

navigation.title: Asset Installation
navigation.description: Record and confirm asset installation/commissioning
navigation.functional_specs: Data points: ASSET_CODE, INSTALLATION_DATE, INSTALLED_BY, INSTALLATION_LOCATION_CONFIRMED (Y/N), INSTALLATION_CERTIFICATE_ATTACHMENT, REMARKS, STATUS (Pending/Confirmed). Actions: Search, Add, Edit (Pending only), Submit-for-approval, Approve, Cancel. Rules: ASSET_CODE must be Capitalized; INSTALLATION_DATE >= CAPITALIZATION_DATE; one active installation record per asset. On Approve, Asset Register PUT_TO_USE_DATE is set and used as depreciation start date where later than capitalization.

navigation.title: Asset Transfer
navigation.description: Move assets between branch/location/department/employee
navigation.functional_specs: Data points: TRANSFER_NO (auto), TRANSFER_DATE, ASSET_CODE, FROM/TO BRANCH_CODE, LOCATION_CODE, DEPARTMENT_CODE, EMPLOYEE_CODE, TRANSFER_REASON, STATUS (Draft/Pending Approval/Approved/Cancelled). Actions: Search, Add, Edit (Draft only), Submit-for-approval, Approve, Cancel. Rules: TO combination must differ from FROM; ASSET_CODE must be Capitalized/Active; FROM values default from and must match current asset location. On Approve, Asset Register current location/custody fields updated and transfer history retained for audit.

navigation.title: Asset Sale / Scrap
navigation.description: Record asset disposal by sale or scrap
navigation.functional_specs: Data points: DISPOSAL_NO (auto), DISPOSAL_DATE, ASSET_CODE, DISPOSAL_TYPE (Sale/Scrap), SALE_VALUE, BUYER_OR_SCRAP_VENDOR_CODE, NET_BOOK_VALUE_AS_ON_DISPOSAL (computed), PROFIT_LOSS_ON_DISPOSAL (computed), DISPOSAL_REASON, STATUS (Draft/Pending Approval/Approved/Cancelled). Actions: Search, Add, Edit (Draft only), Submit-for-approval, Approve, Cancel. Rules: asset must not already be Disposed; DISPOSAL_DATE >= CAPITALIZATION_DATE; PROFIT_LOSS_ON_DISPOSAL = SALE_VALUE - NBV; SALE_VALUE mandatory for Sale. On Approve, Asset Register STATUS = Disposed and asset excluded from future depreciation generation and Income Tax block.

navigation.title: Physical Verification
navigation.description: Periodic physical confirmation of assets
navigation.functional_specs: Groups physical verification cycle planning and execution activities

navigation.title: Conduct Physical Verification
navigation.description: Plan a physical verification list: select branch, location and asset category, pull in assets not verified in the last X months, and assign the list to an employee.
navigation.functional_specs: Header: VERIFICATION_CYCLE_NO (auto), VERIFICATION_DATE, BRANCH_CODE, LOCATION_CODE, CATEGORY_CODE (optional filter, lookup FAM_ASSET_CATEGORY_MASTER.CATEGORY_CODE), NOT_VERIFIED_SINCE_MONTHS (number, X months since last verification), VERIFIER_EMPLOYEE_CODE (assignee), STATUS (Planned/In Progress/Pending Approval/Closed/Cancelled). Lines: ASSET_CODE, ASSET_NAME, EXPECTED_LOCATION_CODE, EXPECTED_EMPLOYEE_CODE, PHYSICAL_STATUS_FOUND, VERIFIED_DATE, REMARKS, ASSET_PHOTO_URL. The Load Assets action offers capitalized FAM_ASSET_REGISTER assets at the header BRANCH_CODE/LOCATION_CODE, optionally filtered by CATEGORY_CODE, excluding assets whose latest FAM_PHYSICAL_VERIFICATION_LINE.VERIFIED_DATE is within the last NOT_VERIFIED_SINCE_MONTHS months and excluding assets already on the cycle. Actual physical checking now happens on the separate fam_verification_execution screen. Detail form (FAM_PHYSICAL_VERIFICATION_LINE) additionally carries SCAN_QR_IMAGE_URL, an optional image column the verifier can fill by picking a photo from the device or capturing one with the camera. The existing 'Scan to Confirm' row action now accepts that image: it decodes the QR/barcode in the picked image, normalises the payload to an ASSET_CODE, checks the asset is part of this verification cycle, and fills the line's ASSET_CODE, ASSET_NAME, EXPECTED_LOCATION_CODE and EXPECTED_EMPLOYEE_CODE from FAM_ASSET_REGISTER before stamping VERIFIED_DATE and PHYSICAL_STATUS_FOUND. When no image is supplied the action falls back to the ASSET_CODE keyed on the line, so the existing manual flow is unchanged.

navigation.title: Execute Physical Verification
navigation.description: Execute an assigned verification list — scan or key an asset id, validate it belongs to the list, and record its physical status, remarks and photo. The asset id can be captured by scanning its QR/barcode with the device camera or keyed manually.
navigation.functional_specs: Transaction over the existing verification tables. Header form (main_table FAM_PHYSICAL_VERIFICATION): VERIFICATION_CYCLE_NO (key, selected from cycles whose STATUS is PLANNED or IN_PROGRESS and that are assigned to the logged-in user via VERIFIER_EMPLOYEE_CODE), display-only VERIFICATION_DATE, BRANCH_CODE/branch_name, LOCATION_CODE/location_name, VERIFIER_EMPLOYEE_CODE/verifier_employee_name and STATUS; plus a SCAN_ASSET_CODE VARCHAR(20) capture field used for barcode/QR scan or manual asset-id entry. Header action "Scan Asset" runs business logic scan_asset_into_verification: it rejects an asset code that is not already a line of this cycle in FAM_PHYSICAL_VERIFICATION_LINE, and on a match stamps that line PHYSICAL_STATUS_FOUND = FOUND with VERIFIED_DATE = today and moves the header STATUS from PLANNED to IN_PROGRESS. Detail form (main_table FAM_PHYSICAL_VERIFICATION_LINE, parent_key_col VERIFICATION_CYCLE_NO): ASSET_CODE and ASSET_NAME read-only, editable PHYSICAL_STATUS_FOUND (FOUND/NOT_FOUND/DAMAGED/EXTRA_UNREGISTERED), VERIFIED_DATE, REMARKS, ASSET_PHOTO_URL, and read-only EXPECTED_LOCATION_CODE/EXPECTED_EMPLOYEE_CODE. No Add or Delete actions on the detail form — the asset list is fixed when the cycle is planned. The header form field SCAN_ASSET_CODE supports device QR/barcode scan capture: the top-of-form Scan Asset action opens the device camera scanner, the decoded value is normalised (trimmed, upper-cased, ASSET_CODE extracted when the payload is a URL or ASSET_CODE=<code> text) and placed into SCAN_ASSET_CODE, after which the existing action validations (PV_SCAN_EMPTY, PV_SCAN_NO_CYCLE, PV_SCAN_STATUS, PV_SCAN_NOT_IN_LIST) and the scan_asset_into_verification business logic run unchanged to stamp the matching FAM_PHYSICAL_VERIFICATION_LINE row as FOUND. Manual key-in of SCAN_ASSET_CODE remains supported; cancelling the scanner records nothing.

navigation.title: Warranty & AMC
navigation.description: Warranty coverage and Annual Maintenance Contracts
navigation.functional_specs: Groups warranty detail tracking and AMC contract management activities

navigation.title: Warranty Details
navigation.description: Record manufacturer/vendor warranty coverage
navigation.functional_specs: Data points: ASSET_CODE, WARRANTY_PROVIDER_VENDOR_CODE, WARRANTY_START_DATE, WARRANTY_END_DATE, WARRANTY_TERMS, WARRANTY_DOCUMENT_ATTACHMENT. Actions: Search, Add, Edit. Rules: WARRANTY_END_DATE > WARRANTY_START_DATE; ASSET_CODE must exist and be Capitalized. Feeds Warranty / AMC Expiry visual.

navigation.title: AMC Contracts
navigation.description: Track Annual Maintenance Contracts and renewals
navigation.functional_specs: Header: AMC_CONTRACT_NO (auto), AMC_VENDOR_CODE, START_DATE, END_DATE, CONTRACT_COST, STATUS (Active/Expired/Renewed/Cancelled), PREVIOUS_CONTRACT_NO. Lines: ASSET_CODE, ASSET_NAME, COVERAGE_REMARKS. Actions: Search, Add, Edit, Renew, Submit-for-approval, Approve, Cancel. Rules: END_DATE > START_DATE; each line asset must be Capitalized; renewal creates new contract linked to previous and sets prior to Renewed. On Approve, covered assets flagged AMC_APPLICABLE = Y; feeds Warranty / AMC Expiry visual. Trigger: send-notification to asset owner/branch when warranty or AMC coverage is within 30 days of expiry.

navigation.title: Reports & Analytics
navigation.description: Statutory reports, expiry visuals and management dashboard
navigation.functional_specs: Groups statutory print reports, BI visuals and the management dashboard

navigation.title: Verification Report
navigation.description: Physical verification confirmation document
navigation.functional_specs: Criteria: VERIFICATION_CYCLE_NO, BRANCH_CODE, LOCATION_CODE, VERIFICATION_DATE range. Grouped by LOCATION_CODE with count of assets by PHYSICAL_STATUS_FOUND per location and grand total verified count. Columns: ASSET_CODE, ASSET_NAME, EXPECTED_LOCATION_CODE, PHYSICAL_STATUS_FOUND, REMARKS, VERIFIED_DATE. Footer signature blocks for Verifier and Approver.

navigation.title: Warranty / AMC Expiry
navigation.description: Grid of warranty and AMC coverage approaching expiry
navigation.functional_specs: Grid visualization. Criteria: BRANCH_CODE, LOCATION_CODE, TYPE (Warranty/AMC), EXPIRY_DATE range, STATUS. Data points: ASSET_CODE, ASSET_NAME, TYPE, PROVIDER_VENDOR_CODE, START_DATE, END_DATE, DAYS_TO_EXPIRY, STATUS. Drill-down: clicking ASSET_CODE opens Asset Register detail for that asset.

navigation.title: Asset Movement History
navigation.description: Asset-wise physical movement/transfer trail across branch, location, department and custodian
navigation.functional_specs: Grid visualization listing FAM_ASSET_TRANSFER records, one row per transfer/movement event, sorted asset-wise then chronologically (TRANSFER_DATE ascending) so it reads as a per-asset movement trail. Criteria: ASSET_CODE (optional F2 lookup against FAM_ASSET_REGISTER to pick one specific asset), CATEGORY_CODE (optional F2 lookup against FAM_ASSET_CATEGORY_MASTER to see a whole category's movement history), STATUS (defaults to APPROVED — only Approved transfers are actual completed physical moves; user can broaden to Draft/Pending Approval/Cancelled). Columns: ASSET_CODE, ASSET_NAME, CATEGORY_NAME (via FAM_ASSET_REGISTER join), TRANSFER_NO, TRANSFER_DATE, STATUS, FROM_BRANCH_NAME, FROM_LOCATION_NAME, FROM_DEPARTMENT_NAME, FROM_EMPLOYEE_NAME, TO_BRANCH_NAME, TO_LOCATION_NAME, TO_DEPARTMENT_NAME, TO_EMPLOYEE_NAME, TRANSFER_REASON.

navigation.title: Management Dashboard
navigation.description: Consolidated asset, depreciation and verification KPIs for Asset/Finance Manager
navigation.functional_specs: Criteria: FINANCIAL_YEAR (default current FY), BRANCH_CODE (default logged-in user's branch, selectable All). Visuals: Total Gross Asset Value (Card+sparkline), Total Net Book Value (Card), Assets Pending Approval (Card), Warranty/AMC Expiring in 30 Days (Card, drills to Warranty / AMC Expiry), Asset Value by Category (Doughnut-Chart, drills to Asset Register Report), Asset Count by Location (Column-Chart, drills to Asset Register Report), Monthly Depreciation Trend - Companies Act (Line-Chart, drills to Depreciation Register), Depreciation Comparison Companies Act vs Income Tax (Stacked-Column-Chart, drills to Depreciation Register), Physical Verification Status (Pie-Chart, drills to Verification Report), Asset Disposal Value Sale vs Scrap (Waterfall, drills to Asset Register Report filtered to disposed), Monthly Depreciation Posting Compliance (Gauge vs 100% target).

navigation.title: Asset Depreciation Reconciliation (CA vs IT)
navigation.description: Per-asset period-wise depreciation detail for reconciliation
navigation.functional_specs: Pick one asset (ASSET_CODE lookup) to see two panels side by side: (1) Companies Act — every posted/draft period from FAM_DEP_COMPANIES_ACT_REGISTER for that asset (opening WDV, additions, disposals, monthly depreciation, closing WDV, accumulated depreciation, status), real per-asset figures generated by the 'Generate Depreciation - Companies Act' process; (2) Income Tax — every year's row from FAM_DEP_INCOME_TAX_BLOCK for the Income Tax block the asset belongs to (block-level opening/additions/disposals/rate/depreciation/closing WDV/status, generated by 'Generate Income Tax Block Depreciation'), clearly labeled as block-level (not a statutory per-asset figure) plus one extra estimated column allocating the block's depreciation to this asset pro-rata by its share of the block's capitalized cost, for reconciliation against the Companies Act figure. Both panels populate only after the corresponding Generate + Approve & Post cycle has been run at least once for that period/year.

navigation.title: Income Tax Depreciation - Asset Ledger (Form 3CD)
navigation.description: Asset-level Income Tax depreciation ledger for Tax Audit Form 3CD Clause 18 disclosure
navigation.functional_specs:
Generates a per-asset, per-Assessment-Year Income Tax depreciation ledger to satisfy Tax Audit Form 3CD Clause 18, which requires depreciation-claimed particulars at asset level. Under the Income Tax Act depreciation is computed and legally exists only at BLOCK level (see the sibling process "Generate Depreciation - Income Tax"); this process does NOT recompute the statutory figure. Instead it takes each block's already-computed annual depreciation amount and ALLOCATES it across the block's member assets on a documented proportional basis, purely for disclosure/record-keeping.

Criteria: Assessment Year (number, required), Block Code (dropdown from Depreciation Rate Master - Income Tax, default ALL), Branch (dropdown from Branch Master, default ALL).

Source logic: recomputes the same block-wise WDV depreciation as the sibling block process (opening WDV incl. the block's legacy Opening WDV/As-On-Date onboarding fields, additions split by the 180-day put-to-use rule at full/half rate, disposals during the year, rate from the Income Tax Rate Master, depreciation amount capped at net block). For each eligible asset (has a Capitalization Date and an Income Tax Block Code) it then determines: RATE_CATEGORY (DISPOSED / ADDITION_FULL_RATE / ADDITION_HALF_RATE / OPENING_BLOCK_MEMBER / NOT_ELIGIBLE) and an allocation weight — its own acquisition cost for a full-rate addition this year, half its cost for a half-rate addition, its own legacy Income Tax Opening WDV seed (from the Asset Register's Income Tax Opening WDV / Income Tax Opening WDV As On Date fields) if it was already a block member before this financial year, or 0 if disposed during the year. DEPRECIATION_ALLOCATED = the block's total depreciation amount x this asset's weight / sum of weights of all its block's member assets. GROSS_BLOCK is always the asset's own full acquisition cost. OPENING_WDV_ALLOCATED and CLOSING_WDV_ALLOCATED are shown per asset on the same allocation basis.

Output columns per row (one per Assessment Year + Asset): Assessment Year, Asset Code, Asset Name, Block Code, Block Description, Branch Code Filter, Rate Category, Gross Block, Opening WDV Allocated, Depreciation Allocated, Closing WDV Allocated, Already Posted, Remarks, Status.

Workflow: Generate (run the process and review/edit the grid), edit Remarks and Status (DRAFT/PENDING_APPROVAL/APPROVED/CANCELLED), Execute persists the rows into FAM_DEP_IT_ASSET_LEDGER keyed by Assessment Year + Asset Code (upsert); setting Status=APPROVED and Executing is the Approve & Post step. A validation blocks re-generating an asset's year that is already Approved & Posted.

navigation.title: Asset Verification Coverage by Category
navigation.functional_specs: Table showing, per Asset Category, the count of active (STATUS='ACTIVE') assets, how many were physically verified within the selected period (a verification cycle line with VERIFIED_DATE in range), and the resulting % Verified. Criteria: Asset Category (optional, lookup to Asset Category Master, defaults to all categories) and Verification Period From date (defaults to 12 months before today; the upper bound is always the current date).

navigation.title: Assets Not Under AMC
navigation.functional_specs: Grid listing assets from the Asset Register that are NOT currently covered by any AMC contract (AMC_APPLICABLE flag is not 'Y'). Shows Asset Code, Asset Name, Category, Branch, Status, Make, Model, Purchase Date and Purchase Cost. Filterable by Asset Category and Branch (both optional, default to all).

navigation.title: AMC Coverage & Expiry
navigation.functional_specs: Grid showing AMC contract details together with each covered asset (Contract No, Vendor, Contract Start/End Date, Contract Status, Asset Code, Asset Name, Branch, Category, Days to Expiry, Expiry Indicator) for contract lines whose coverage END_DATE is on or before a selected "Expiring On or Before" date (default today) — i.e. assets whose AMC has already expired or will expire by that date. Filterable by Branch, with an "All Branches" default. Sorted by End Date ascending (most overdue/soonest expiring first).

navigation.title: Asset QR Code Tag
navigation.description: Printable QR code label for a single asset
navigation.functional_specs: Label-format Jasper report (A5 landscape, 595 x 420 pt, PDF by default, HTML also available) printing one asset's scannable QR tag. Criterion: ASSET_CODE (prompt with F2 lookup on FAM_ASSET_REGISTER showing ASSET_NAME, pre-filled with the first asset so it always opens rendered). Renders a QR code encoding COALESCE(NULLIF(QR_BARCODE_TAG,''), 'FAM|'||ASSET_CODE) with the payload printed beneath it in monospace, alongside Asset Code, Asset Name, Category Name, Branch - Location, Serial No and Make/Model. Sourced from FAM_ASSET_REGISTER joined to FAM_ASSET_CATEGORY_MASTER, FAM_BRANCH_MASTER and FAM_LOCATION_MASTER (location join on BRANCH_CODE + LOCATION_CODE, its composite key). Also opened from the Asset Register screen's row action "Generate QR/Barcode Tag".
